pedagogical_framework.title: Pedagogical Principles & Systematic Grammar Guide of Surah Al-Asr

trilateral_word_classification.ism: Encompasses Al-Asr (time/oath), Al-Insan (mankind), Khusr (loss), Al-Ladhina (relative pronoun), Al-Salihat (righteous deeds), Al-Haqq (truth), and Al-Sabr (patience).
trilateral_word_classification.fil: Includes Form IV verb 'Amanu' (believed), Form I verb 'Amilu' (worked/performed), and Form VI verb 'Tawasaw' (enjoined/advised one another).
trilateral_word_classification.harf: Includes Waw al-Qasam (oath particle), Inna (emphatic particle), Lam al-Muzahlaqah (emphatic attached particle), Illa (exception particle), Waw al-Atf (conjunction), and Ba al-Jarr (preposition).

pedagogical_framework.core_surah_thesis: Imam Al-Shafi'i noted: 'If Allah had revealed no other surah to His creation except this surah, it would have been sufficient for them.' It outlines the universal law of human salvation across four essential pillars: Faith (Iman), Righteous Action (Amal Salih), Mutual Enjoining of Truth (Tawasi bil-Haqq), and Mutual Enjoining of Steadfast Patience (Tawasi bis-Sabr).

thematic_sections.title_en: The Divine Oath by Time & The Universal Condition of Mankind in Loss
thematic_sections.title_ar: القسم بالعصر وبيان خسران الجنس البشري
thematic_sections.summary: Allah swears by Al-Asr (Time / The Declining Day) that every human being is intrinsically trapped in a state of absolute depletion and loss (Khusr).

thematic_sections.title_en: The Four Divine Qualifications for Salvation and Eternal Success
thematic_sections.summary: The exception to universal loss: those who embody Faith, perform Righteous Deeds, and actively build a resilient community through mutual recommendation of Truth and Patience.

qasam.purpose: Emphasizing the value of time as the capital asset of human existence.

ijaz.description: Omission of the oath verb (أقسم) for immediate dramatic impact.

aqidah.divine_oath_significance: Allah swears by created phenomena like Time to demonstrate their grand cosmic sign value and gravity for human accountability.

sarf.root_meaning: to press, squeeze out, decline of day, time era

irab_and_case.case_concept: Dragging / Pulling down (الجر) — Governed by oath particle Waw.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: اسم مجرور بواو القسم وعلامة جره الكسرة الظاهرة
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Preceded by Waw al-Qasam (واو القسم), which functions grammatically as a Harf Jarr (preposition).

morphemes.role: Oath particle (واو القسم) acting as preposition

verses.thematic_section_title: Universal Condition of Mankind in Loss

tawkid.rhetorical_purpose: Removing any doubt regarding the reality of human decay without spiritual intervention.

tanker_for_magnification.effect: Tanween al-Ta'dheem / al-Tahweel — designating an immense, terrifying, and total loss.

zarfiyyah_metaphor.effect: Using the preposition 'Fi' (in) depicts loss as a container or deep ocean in which human beings are fully submerged.

aqidah.human_nature: Left to pure material inclinations, human existence continuously depreciates in spiritual value with every passing second.

details.particle_type_ar: حرف توكيد ونصب (Harf of Emphasis and Accusative Governance)

irab_and_case.case_concept: Fixed base (المبني) — Particle built on Fatha.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: حرف توكيد ونصب مبني على الفتح لا محل له من الإعراب
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Fixed particle (مبني على الفتح) that enters nominal sentences, making the subject منصوب (Nasb).

details.derivation_ar: اسم جنس لاستغراق الاستغراق (Generic Collective Noun)

irab_and_case.case_concept: Setting up / Erecting (النصب) — Subject of Inna.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: اسم إن منصوب وعلامة نصبه الفتحة الظاهرة
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Takes Fatha (Accusative) because it functions as the subject (Ism) governed by Inna.

morphemes.role: Generic definite article (لام الجنس لاستغراق الأفراد)

details.particle_type_ar: لام المزحلقة + حرف جر (Emphatic Lam + Preposition Fi)

irab_and_case.case_concept: Fixed base (المبني) — Particles built on fixed vowels.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: اللام المزحلقة حرف توكيد، وفِي حرف جر مبني على السكون
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Fixed particle combining emphatic Lam with preposition Fi.

morphemes.role: Emphatic attached Lam (اللام المزحلقة في خبر إن)

sarf.root_meaning: to lose, suffer deficit, ruin, perish

irab_and_case.case_concept: Dragging / Pulling down (الجر) — Governed by preposition Fi.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: اسم مجرور بفي وعلامة جره الكسرة الظاهرة، والجار والمجرور خسران في محل رفع خبر إن
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Governed by preposition Fi (في). The phrase 'في خسر' forms the predicate (Khabar) of Inna.

morphemes.role: Noun stem in genitive case with indefinite tanween

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
verses.text_imlaei: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
verses.translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
verses.thematic_section_title: The Four Divine Qualifications for Salvation

primary_structure.silat_al_mewsool: آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ

istithna.rhetorical_effect: Confining true success exclusively to those who combine all four internal and social virtues.

tikrar.rhetorical_effect: Repetition of Form VI reciprocal verb highlights the indispensable dual pillars of social solidarity: Truth and Endurance.

form_vi_reciprocity.semantic_implication: Signifies mandatory mutual exchange; faith is not solitary but requires communal encouragement.

four_pillars_of_salvation: 3. Tawasi bil-Haqq (Promoting Truth, Justice, and Dawah)

irab_and_case.case_concept: Fixed base (المبني) — Particle built on Sukun.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: حرف استثناء مبني على السكون لا محل له من الإعراب
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Fixed particle of exception built on Sukun.

irab_and_case.case_concept: Fixed base (المبني) — In local Accusative position (في محل نصب مستثنى).
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: اسم موصول مبني على الفتح في محل نصب مستثنى بإلا
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Fixed relative pronoun built on Fatha, occupying the local accusative case as the excepted entity (Mustathna).

details.form_meaning: Form IV: Causative / Transitive Faith (Affirming Security & Truth)

sarf.root_meaning: to be safe, trust, believe, grant security

irab_and_case.case_concept: Fixed base (المبني) — Past verb built on Dhumma due to attached Waw al-Jama'ah.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: فعل ماضٍ مبني على الضم لاتصاله بواو الجماعة، والواو ضمير متصل في محل رفع فاعل
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Past verb built on Dhumma (مبني على الضم) because of attached masculine plural pronoun Waw.

morphemes.role: Form IV past active verb stem
Subject pronoun Waw al-Jama'ah (واو الجماعة فاعل)

sarf.root_meaning: to work, perform action, labor, execute

irab_and_case.case_concept: Fixed base (المبني) — Past verb built on Dhumma.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: الواو عاطفة، عملوا فعل ماضٍ مبني على الضم، والواو فاعل
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Conjoined past verb built on Dhumma due to Waw al-Jama'ah.

morphemes.role: Form I past active verb stem

details.derivation_ar: جمع مؤنث سالم لاسم الفاعل (Sound Feminine Plural Active Participle)

sarf.root_meaning: to be good, righteous, proper, beneficial, sound

irab_and_case.case_concept: Setting up / Erecting (النصب) — Subordinated direct object taking Kasra as substitute marker.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: مفعول به منصوب وعلامة نصبه الكسرة نيابة عن الفتحة لأنه جمع مؤنث سالم
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Takes Kasra instead of Fatha because sound feminine plurals (جمع مؤنث سالم) mark Accusative case with Kasra.

morphemes.role: Definite article (لام التعريف المدغمة في الصاد)
Plural active participle stem in accusative case marked by kasra

details.form_meaning: Form VI: Reciprocal mutual cooperation / Enjoining one another

sarf.root_meaning: to enjoin, advise, bequeath, urge mutually

irab_and_case.case_concept: Fixed base (المبني) — Past verb built on estimated Fatha on deleted Alif.
irab_and_case.grammatical_role_ar: الواو عاطفة، تواصوا فعل ماضٍ مبني على الفتح المقدر على الألف المحذوفة لالتقاء الساكنين، والواو فاعل
irab_and_case.why_this_ending: Built on estimated Fatha on the weak root letter deleted to prevent meeting of two silent letters (سكونين).

derived_forms.semantic_implication: Transitive/Causative: entering state of security and affirming truth
Reciprocity: mutual action between two or more parties

balaghah.qasam: Divine oath by Time (العصر) setting the urgent context of human life.
balaghah.tawkid: Triple emphasis in verse 2: Oath + Inna + Lam al-Muzahlaqah.
balaghah.tanker: Khusrin (خسرٍ) with tanween al-tahweel signifying catastrophic loss.
balaghah.majaz_zarfiyyah: Fi Khusr (في خسر) framing loss as an enclosing vessel.
balaghah.repetition: Repeating Tawasaw (تواصوا) to highlight both Truth and Patience as distinct, equal imperatives.

salvation_matrix.default_state: All human beings head towards spiritual bankruptcy (Khusr).
salvation_matrix.exemption: Only achieved by fulfilling all 4 conditions simultaneously: Iman, Amal Salih, Tawasi bil-Haqq, Tawasi bis-Sabr.
